title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-28 06:01:31 最新章节：296 再见沈知上求月票
content_zh:
屋外，夜色如墨。
狂风大作，飙举电至。
轰隆！
黑紫惊雷劈开夜幕。
张泱被这声动静炸醒，蓦地睁开眼。
轰隆！
又是一声响雷。
轻飘飘的灵魂在这一瞬有了重量。
电光顺着开裂土墙缝隙钻进破败屋内。
刹那间黑暗退避，照亮种种——飞溅在墙上的血污、散落在地上的尸块。张泱刚睁眼就看到这诡异一幕，更诡异的是当她下意识想活动双手，下方尸块也跟着同步蠕动。
张泱眯了眯眼，不信邪又动一下。
下方尸块短暂诈尸。
张泱：“……”
她只是过了个图，身体就变一块块了？
“还是哪个策划又在机房烧烤？”
张泱面无表情看着房梁下散装的自己，心里没下不去的慌张，有的只是对游戏策划的亲切问候——碰见这种策划，PC日子难过。
是的，张泱是个PC。
准确来说，张泱是全息游戏开服前意外觉醒意识的PC。从诞生意识那天起，她就发现她跟身边同类不同——那些同类不是整天待一片地方活动，就是翻来覆去重复几句单调对话，仿佛一具具没有灵魂自我的傀儡。
【不能被发现，发现即抹杀！】
【不能被抹杀，抹杀即虚无！】

这两条警告在她诞生之日便如铁律般烙印在她脑海，让她无端生出强烈危机感。冥冥中有种预感，她要做个人！唯有如此才不会被“祂”发现自身特殊，才能免于抹杀。
可是——
人，又是什么？
自己难道不算是人吗？
祂，又是谁？
她没有困惑多久就有了转机。
人口仅一千三的小基地跑来三千万找亲戚的幸存者，除了张泱，没人觉得拾荒老太凭一己之力养活三千万孙子孙女是多离谱的事。随时间推移，孙子孙女大军还在暴涨。
繁殖能力比线面还恐怖。
张泱也从他们口中知道他们才是“人”。
他们自称是“玩家”、“天外来客”。
能抹杀她的“祂”则是游戏官方。
换而言之，张泱这片塑料树叶想保证自身安全，不被抹杀，便要想办法将自身融入名为“玩家”的森林中。如此才是最安全的。
张泱，一个伪装成玩家的PC。
一装就是整整十六年！
还没来得及庆祝自己终于拥有一块家园基地，进入支线地图的时候眼前陡然一黑。
再睁开眼——
content_en:
Outside the house, the night is like ink.
The wind was strong and the lightning was coming.
Boom!
Black and purple thunder split the night.
Zhang Yang was awakened by the noise and suddenly opened his eyes.
Boom!
There was another thunder.
The light soul gained weight at this moment.
The electric light penetrated into the dilapidated house along the cracks in the cracked earth wall.
In an instant, the darkness retreated, illuminating everything - the blood splattered on the wall and the corpses scattered on the ground. Zhang Yang saw this weird scene as soon as she opened her eyes. What was even weirder was that when she subconsciously tried to move her hands, the corpse below also squirmed simultaneously.
Zhang Yang narrowed his eyes and moved again in disbelief.
The corpse below briefly appears as a corpse.
Zhang Yang: "..."
She just passed a picture and her body changed into pieces?
"Or some planner is having a barbecue in the computer room again?"
Zhang Yang looked at himself scattered under the beams with an expressionless face. He was not in a state of panic, but only expressed cordial greetings to the game planner - encountering such a plan would make life difficult for the PC.
Yes, Zhang Yang is a PC.
To be precise, Zhang Yang is the PC who accidentally awakened consciousness before the holographic game was launched. From the day she was born with consciousness, she discovered that she was different from the same kind of people around her - those kindred spirits either stayed in one place all day long, or repeated a few monotonous conversations over and over again, like a puppet without a soul.
[Cannot be discovered, if discovered, it will be erased! 】
[Cannot be erased, erasure is nothingness! 】
These two warnings were imprinted in her mind like an iron law on the day she was born, giving her a strong sense of crisis for no reason. There is a hunch in the dark that she wants to be someone! Only in this way can "He" not discover that he is special and can he avoid being obliterated.
But——
People, what are they?
Don’t you count yourself as a human being?
Who is He?
It didn't take long for her to be confused before things turned around.
A small base with a population of only 1,300 people came to see 30 million survivors looking for relatives. Except for Zhang Yang, no one thought it was outrageous for an old scavenger to support 30 million grandchildren by herself. As time goes by, the army of grandchildren continues to grow.
The reproductive capacity is even more terrifying than the surface.
Zhang Yang also knew from their mouths that they were the "human beings".
They call themselves "players" and "visitors from outside the world".
The "him" who can obliterate her is the game official.
In other words, if Zhang Yang, this plastic leaf, wants to ensure its own safety and not be obliterated, it must find a way to integrate itself into the forest called "Player". This is the safest.
Zhang Yang, a PC pretending to be a player.
Once installed, it lasts for sixteen years!
Before I had time to celebrate that I finally had a home base, my vision suddenly went dark when I entered the branch map.
Open your eyes again——
